key_insight: Full-factorial testing identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide levels for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings offer a process-development starting point: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Use a two-level full factorial design with 24 experimental runs.
Measure coating properties and quantify parameter contributions using ANOVA.
Analyze spray-parameter interactions using Pareto charts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating-response measurements across 24 runs but provides no numerical property values or statistical significance results.
watch_item: Validate the reported settings on the intended equipment before transfer; the abstract does not establish robustness beyond the tested conditions.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
